exact_missing_items: Treat acknowledged as escalation/noise control and ownership visibility, not semantic closure and not blocker removal by itself

Required orchestrator projection families (12): Run Summary, Seam Summary, Package Summary, Node Summary, Promotion Summary, Lane/Worktree Summary, Concern Summary, Account/Usage Pressure, Recent Major Events, Corroboration Summary, Recovery Summary, Overseer Activity
Handoff chain must be: requirements-doc-builder → interview flow → PRD-builder → graph-plan inputs → handoff to Orchestrator; each step has defined output artifacts
Execution-policy settings must allow the user to choose between fresh and retained-context retry workers; these must be separately configurable settings
Worker kind (subagent vs full agent) and retry-context policy (fresh vs retained) are SEPARATE settings — they must not be combined into a single toggle
Overseer-spawned node worker is the NORMAL/DEFAULT execution path, not an edge case — documentation must reflect this as the primary worker model
Node personas must be auto-selected from node scope/type; persona override must be a global node-worker policy setting, NOT a per-node override
Provider/model/effort settings must be available at these levels: run/global, feature seam, work package, node, work package overseer, feature seam overseer, overseer-delegated node worker
